definition: Acoustic environments are the sound conditions in a person’s immediate surroundings, considered as environmental stimuli that can shape emotional and affective responses. In soundscape research, they are studied in relation to how people appraise these surroundings along broad emotional dimensions such as pleasantness and arousal.
